# Cubo

> Cubo is a private dining and events business based in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, founded by chef Michelle Agustin. It cooks seasonal Australian produce in a way rooted in the flavours, techniques and traditions of Asia: not a fusion, but a meeting of cultures. The name comes from the kubo, the simple Filipino hut where people gather, close to nature.

Cubo travels across Melbourne and Victoria for private dinners, supper clubs, wilderness feasts and events. Enquiries go to info.cubo.au@gmail.com or through the enquiry page.

## Experiences

- [In-house Private Chef](/experiences.html#private-chef): a fully hosted chef experience in the client's home, from menu planning to clean-up. Ingredient costs are quoted separately.
- [Private Dining](/experiences.html#private-dining): seasonal set menus for 6–20 guests, from 3 to 6 courses.
- [Wilderness Feasts](/experiences.html#wilderness): outdoor communal dining in natural settings for 20–30 guests, including Around the Fire Gatherings, Cubo's supper club.
- [Bespoke Gatherings](/experiences.html#bespoke): shared feasts built around the client's cuisine, season and style of gathering.
- [Events & Experiences](/experiences.html#events): catering and dining for corporate functions, brand events, weddings and private celebrations.

## Work with Cubo

- [Partnerships](/collaborate.html): collaborations with venues, wineries, farms, glamping sites, pop-ups, festivals and brands.
- [Consulting](/collaborate.html#consulting): concept and menu development, kitchen operations, systems, training and restaurant opening support.

## About

- [About Cubo and Michelle Agustin](/about.html): philosophy (seasonal and local, Asian heritage, nature and culture, no waste) and the founder.
- [Enquire](/enquire.html): plan a gathering.
